strength_thumbnail_click_autoplay.note: playAt() calls v.play() (PremiumReportV2.jsx:172) and swallows rejection via .catch(). In headless Chromium with preload='metadata' the metadata had not finished loading during the test window so play() silently no-ops (video is unmuted → autoplay policy also relevant). In a real user session the click is a valid user gesture and metadata typically loads within ~1s over the CDN, so playback normally starts. Not treated as a blocker; see minor observation below.

regression_free_user_locked_flow.reason: GET /api/reports/mine returned an empty list ([]) — no locked report exists on this account to open in the browser.
regression_free_user_locked_flow.structural_verification: ReportPage.jsx:1971 — `if (unlocked && full_report) { return <PremiumReportV2 .../> }`. `unlocked` derives from is_paid || manually_unlocked; locked reports (both falsy) fall through to the original layout (preview-locked-teaser, PricingCards, HeroTeaser, generating panel). The V2 code path is provably unreachable for locked reports.

action_items: MINOR (UX polish, non-blocking): the <video> element uses preload='metadata' and is not muted. In practice the first strength-thumbnail click correctly seeks to the right timestamp and scrolls into view, but v.play() may be rejected until metadata loads (or muted autoplay). Two options: (a) add muted + autoPlay hint when playAt runs, then re-enable audio after playing begins, or (b) after v.play() rejection, briefly show a 'tap ▶ to play' hint over the video. Cosmetic only — click still works, user just needs to tap the native controls once.

MINOR (data quality, non-blocking): report 62ca3ed0's subject_crop_url returns a valid but ~4.6KB nearly-blank JPEG, so the hero shows an empty dark-green frame. Add a defensive fallback in PremiumReportV2: if the crop < ~8KB or fails to decode, fall back to marker_url / silhouette.
critical_code_review_comments: PremiumReportV2.jsx (222 lines) + sections.jsx (375 lines) + derive.js are clean, well-scoped, and correctly gated behind `unlocked && full_report`. Good separation from the legacy layout.

derive.js fallbacks are robust — the old-format 91476fec report rendered V2 with zero console errors and correctly hid match_stats. That validates the graceful-degradation contract for all pre-existing premium reports.
Header wordmark-only requirement satisfied (V2PageHeader has an explicit `Wordmark only — no logo mark per spec` comment at line 29 of PremiumReportV2.jsx).
ReportPage.jsx is now ~3290 lines — the V2 early-return branch is tidy (lines 1968-2004) but the file remains a split candidate (called out in iter58 as well).

Frame durability: _persist_video_frames + ensure_video_frames properly extracted 5 frames while the video was still local and flushed them to R2/durable /api/media/... paths (all 5 frame_verified=true). The /api/media proxy correctly serves them with image/jpeg and 121KB payloads.

Video autoplay UX: playAt() at PremiumReportV2.jsx:166-174 seeks then calls play() with a silent .catch. This is functionally safe but visually confusing when readyState=0 — consider awaiting `loadedmetadata` before seeking, or setting v.muted=true just for the click-driven autoplay path.

The strength thumbnail image is not lazy-loaded (`loading='lazy'` attribute is missing). With 4 frame images ~120KB each above-the-fold this is fine, but adding loading='lazy' on the video-highlight thumb (which appears further down) would trim TTI on slow connections.

rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bug filed this iteration. Feature verification only. One structural note: the free-user locked-flow live test could not be performed (free@elitescout.com has zero reports), but the V2 branch is provably unreachable for locked reports because ReportPage.jsx:1971 requires BOTH `unlocked === true` AND `full_report` truthy. `unlocked` is derived from is_paid || manually_unlocked, both of which are false on locked free reports; a locked free report has no full_report at all. Therefore locked reports always fall through to the original layout (preview-locked-teaser + PricingCards). This is a code-level invariant, not a runtime observation, so if a regression ever changes that guard, the free-user locked flow must be re-tested live once seed data exists.
